description: Identity-Matrix exceptions (plan §11.2 / K6). Dual-run mismatches must match an entry or fail. K1b documents the approved C2.a catalog-bound routing behaviour.

c2aCatalogBoundRouting.ruleCite: Players_Handbook / Actives: power category and radial segment come from the catalog template (templateId), never from instance name or description. Legacy textSuggestsActiveBuff (stance/buff wording) is a known false positive for Actives such as Damage Transfer. With a valid templateId, getSegmentIdForOption must ignore text heuristics and keep Active→attack (or Active Buff→active-buff from identity). Items without templateId keep the pre-migration text heuristic until Batch E / K8.

approvedBehaviours.note: C2.a already live: textSuggestsActiveBuff skipped when templateId present
Pre-migration legacy heuristic retained until K8
